text: It is highly unusual to have pyelonephritis without urinary symptoms or significant systemic signs like chills. speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of binucleated cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm on the cytospin is a classic sign of eosinophils, which, combined with elevated creatinine and a history of antibiotic use, strongly points to acute interstitial nephritis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis
